onboarding.slide1.title: Ask for anything imported
onboarding.slide1.body: Phones, spare parts, machinery, footwear. Post a request with photos, budget and delivery city — no shipping jargon required.

onboarding.slide2.body: Verified importers submit transparent quotes with delivery windows, warranty and itemized prices. Compare side by side.
onboarding.slide3.title: Tracked to your doorstep
onboarding.slide3.body: Every order is tracked. Payments are reviewed by our team. Delivery is confirmed before completion. Disputes have a real process.

guide.contactSubtitle: Questions or feedback? Tap a channel to copy it.
guide.buyer.step1.title: Post your request
guide.buyer.step1.body: Describe what you want imported — photos, budget and delivery city. No shipping jargon needed; verified importers understand the rest.
guide.buyer.step1.p1: Add clear photos and exact specifications
guide.buyer.step1.p3: Choose the city where it should arrive
guide.buyer.step2.title: Importers quote you
guide.buyer.step2.body: Approved importers respond with itemized quotations — unit price, delivery window and warranty — so every offer is comparable.
guide.buyer.step2.p1: Only verified importers can quote you
guide.buyer.step2.p3: Ask questions in the built-in chat
guide.buyer.step3.title: Compare & accept
guide.buyer.step3.body: Line the quotations up side by side. The cheapest is not always best — weigh delivery time, warranty and rating, then accept.
guide.buyer.step3.p1: Compare price, warranty and delivery time
guide.buyer.step3.p2: Accepting locks the deal for both sides
guide.buyer.step3.p3: Keep every agreement inside the app
guide.buyer.step4.title: Pay with protection
guide.buyer.step4.body: Follow the in-app payment instructions and upload your evidence. Our team verifies the payment before the importer ships anything.
guide.buyer.step4.p1: Submit payment evidence in the app
guide.buyer.step4.p2: Every payment is reviewed by our team
guide.buyer.step5.title: Track to your door
guide.buyer.step5.body: Follow each status update from warehouse to doorstep. Confirm the delivery, then leave a review that helps the whole marketplace.
guide.buyer.step5.p2: Confirm delivery to complete the order
guide.buyer.finale.title: You're ready to source
guide.buyer.finale.subtitle: Post a request and let verified importers compete for it. That is the whole idea — you describe, they deliver.
guide.importer.step1.title: Get verified first
guide.importer.step1.body: Submit your trade licence through verification. Once approved, a verified badge appears on your profile and every quotation you send.
guide.importer.step1.p3: The badge makes buyers trust you
guide.importer.step2.title: Set up your profile
guide.importer.step2.body: A complete business profile wins orders. Add your company details and the categories you source best, and keep them up to date.
guide.importer.step2.p2: Pick the categories you source best
guide.importer.step3.title: Browse live requests
guide.importer.step3.body: New sourcing requests arrive every day. Filter by category and city, read the requirements carefully, and quote what you can deliver.
guide.importer.step3.p1: Filter requests by category and city
guide.importer.step3.p3: Check specs and budget before quoting
guide.importer.step4.title: Quote to win
guide.importer.step4.body: Send clear, itemized quotations early. State your price, delivery window and warranty — fast, accurate quotes win the order.
guide.importer.step5.title: Fulfil, get paid, grow
guide.importer.step5.body: Keep the order status updated and share tracking as you ship. After the buyer confirms delivery, your reputation keeps growing.
guide.importer.step5.p1: Update order status as you progress
guide.importer.finale.title: You're ready to trade
guide.importer.finale.subtitle: Complete verification, browse the live requests and send your first quotation today — buyers are already waiting.
